Nuevo Laredo's firefighters are marking 100 years of service with a historic show of support from City Hall.

Mayor Carmen Lilia Canturosas Villarreal announced that her administration has invested more than 70 million pesos in the Heroico Cuerpo de Bomberos' equipment, infrastructure, and operational capacity, according to elReporteroMx, which reported on the centennial celebration on November 5.

The investment has brought specialized vehicles, ambulances, self-contained breathing equipment, recharge stations, hoses, nozzles, specialized tools, and recent-model fire trucks to the department, according to the report.

A new firefighter training field has also been built inside Parque Viveros, in the colonia of the same name. The 455-square-meter facility represented an investment of 3,392,882 pesos, according to the report.

As part of the recognition, the mayor announced a 5,000-peso bonus for each of the 66 members of the department, in gratitude for their vocation, commitment, and service to the community.

The mayor said recognition for the firefighters' dedication cannot stop at words, and must translate into better tools, preparation, and conditions so they can do their work and return home safely. She added that investing in emergency services means investing in the peace of mind of families, the protection of their homes, and the city's ability to respond when lives and property are at risk.

The Heroico Cuerpo de Bomberos traces its roots to 1926, when citizens laid its foundations. A century later, the mayor recognized the generations of women and men who have built the department's reputation, from those early founders to the firefighters serving today.

Sources: elReporteroMx, reporting on the Nuevo Laredo firefighters' centennial and the municipal investment announcement, November 5, 2026.

title: Nuevo Laredo marks 100 years of firefighters with historic investment and bonuses
